QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is declared with default `off` at `include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787`, and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` is default `off` at `:2196`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says both threading macros (THREADING_C and THREADING_PTHREAD) are off by default in the shipped mbedtls_config.h, so a default build defines neither.
